6ffb549ac1ab6a35.desc: With six solo albums to his credit and multi-platinum sales of over 15 million copies, Juanes is the world’s leading all-Spanish language rock artist. Juanes is also frequently recognized as one of the Spanish-speaking world’s leading social media voices with an online following of over 10 Million fans.  The Colombian superstar’s dedication as a global activist also extends far beyond his passionate lyrics and is seen in his wide ranging charitable work for his own Mi Sangre Foundation and as a co-founder of the "Paz sin Fronteras" (Peace Without Borders) organization - which utilizes music to unite populaces regardless of political or geographic divides and advocate that all people are entitled to the basic human right of peace.

6f7b2d1365e9223d.title: Werewolf by Night & Headless
6f7b2d1365e9223d.desc: Academy Award-winning composer and director Michael Giacchino brings a Halloween doubleheader to the Walt Disney Concert Hall stage! The night kicks off with an exciting first look at Headless, a new musical from Giacchino and collaborators Elyssa Samsel and Kate Anderson. Inspired by Washington Irving’s The Legend of Sleepy Hollow, Headless lures audiences into the bewitched town that has captivated audiences for over two hundred years, but this tale has a twist. Following intermission, the orchestra performs the score of Giacchino’s Werewolf by Night live to picture. Called a “full-on endorphin rush for horror nerds,” Werewolf by Night follows a secret cabal of monster hunters thrust into a mysterious and deadly competition for a powerful relic that will bring them face-to-face with more than one monster. Inspired by the gothic-style horror films of the 1930s and 1940s, the chilling special brings Marvel’s horror comics history to life with style and suspense.
